problem: Dan's right ear is visible and has no yellow pencil behind it (back view).

problem: System warning (first line, y 0.5) is placed below Dan (0.03) and Mira (0.03) bubbles, so reading order does not match line order.

notes: Video 11: same composition as the still, thread and lightning intensify, hand with jar leaves frame, background drifts to grey - acceptable (valid only if the still stays). Video 17: still has plaster/bandage and System text; in the video Mira turns into a different woman (wavy hair, green scarf, no ponytail), the System window gains letters-like squiggles, teal swirls and sparks flood the frame (redo). Story: the trade scene (p4-p12) is the strongest and clearest part, the memory beat in p9 is short but moving; p7 SISTER hint is subtle and works, but the Keeper's price/deal rules (a name for a word) are explained twice (p4 and p5) and slow the pace; p14-p15 office reveal is great but 'a phone ringing' on the desk should be visible in the slit (it is) - the weak spot is that Keeper's 'one more word' leaves the logic of why he opened the door open. The Keeper looks like three different characters (p3 throne, p5 skeleton, p14 standing) which hurts the reveal.
